title: Register route as the control loop's fourth role
action:
Add a fourth `Role::Route` variant to the herding control loop and register it at every one of the eight closed sites the existing three roles occupy, then prove the registration with tests.

The eight sites, each verified at these exact anchors in plan.md's claims table:
1. the `Role` enum (control_loop.rs around :58-67)
2. `Role::parse` — add `"route" => Some(Role::Route)` (:72-75)
3. `Role::as_str` — add `Role::Route => "route"` (:81-83); this is what builds the prompt-file name
4. `Role::default_interval` (:93-94) — give route its own arm. Ship 300 seconds and say in the code comment that the number is a STARTING GUESS, not a measurement (plan.md OQ5): dispatch/merge run at 60s and supervisor at 900s, and nobody has measured how long a review takes in this repo.
5. the `--role` refusal string (:153) — it must now name all four
6. the missing-role message (:195) — same
7. the usage line (:225) — same
8. `allowed_tools_for` (:273-291) — add BOTH transport arms for Route

The tool surface is the load-bearing part. Model it on `SUPERVISOR_ALLOWED_TOOLS` (:299-309): enumerate verbs one by one, never the `Bash(.bee/bin/bee:*)` wildcard. Route needs, and gets, exactly: `bee status`, `bee orient`, `bee worktree list`, `bee cells list`, `bee herding occupancy`, `bee herding pane list`, `bee herding pane read`, `bee herding pane send-text`, `git -C` reads (`status`, `rev-parse`), `ls`, and `Read`. It must NOT carry `Write`, `Edit`, `Bash(git:*)`, `Bash(herdr:*)`, `Bash(tmux:*)`, `Task`, or the bee wildcard. Like the supervisor's, the surface is identical on both transports because route reaches panes only through the transport-neutral `bee herding pane` verbs.

Slice 1 is READ-AND-ANNOUNCE only. Do not add the reviewer dispatch, the review marker, `bee reviews`, or `bee cells add` to the surface — those arrive with slice 2.

truths: `--role rout` refuses and the message names all four roles, not three

route's tool surface is the same string on the herdr and tmux arms
the three existing roles' tool surfaces are byte-unchanged
